propositions: Snapshot-GC worker lock (snapshot-store/gc/worker.lock) is not censused by doctor_locks.scan_locks, leaving stale locks invisible when worker dies between acquire and release
Doctor's lock census must add a sixth leg (snapshot-gc-worker) to probe the per-host snapshot store via a read-only derivation that does not create directories or side effects
The snapshot-gc-worker leg must use the same shared stamped_file_lock/lock_owner staleness table as other stamped legs (drain, compact-worker) with _existence_report as reader
A non-existent snapshot store must report the snapshot-gc-worker leg as free without creating the store directory, matching the read-only diagnostic guarantee
The snapshot-gc-worker leg's root derivation must be read-only and non-creating, separated from gc_trigger's mkdir/chmod side effects via new peek_store_root() and worker_lock_probe_path() functions
